headline: Weathered Expanse Ablaze Anew as Kuura Strand Breaks
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse, gone quiet at the noon filing, has reopened with a fury: sixty-one events across the day, seven of them in the past two hours and the latest logged as this dispatch closed, its ledger now five Colonial works against four unclaimed, the lone Warden post no longer counted among the stands. Casualties there run past eight thousand Colonial and twelve thousand Warden in the day, the heaviest on any desk. On the northern strand at Kuura, fifteen events fell in two hours, the newest at this hour; Martti and Menneen are the busiest stations, with five works still Warden and one Colonial. The Nevish Line reports sixteen events, five Warden works against three Colonial, Grief Mother the hottest. Fisherman's Row shows eleven events and reads one Warden, seven Colonial, one unclaimed. Stlican Shelf stands seven Colonial to two Warden, Breaker Town busiest of its day. Callahan's Passage, all ten works Warden, has quieted these two hours though its casualties grind on; Palantine Berm, fifty-one events yesterday, is likewise silent. No victory is declared on this, the five hundred and twenty-ninth day, with thirty-four victory towns the mark.
